Keep head neck spine resting neutral, no crunch. Generous margins so raised overhead fingertips and feet remain within each quadrant. Identical model, clothes, lighting, viewpoint and scale in every panel. Crisp realistic anatomical illustration, no flesh tones, no labels, no numbers, no extra limbs.
